description: Window cleaning on the Comanche Trail peninsula by Mansfield Dam. Pure water for lake spray, from about $10 a window with a $200 minimum. Quote by text.
h1_em: on the peninsula by the dam.
intro: Comanche Trail is the quiet peninsula by Mansfield Dam, between Windy Point and Hippie Hollow parks, where custom homes sit above Lake Travis. CleanzATX is a Lakeway company and cleans windows here regularly.

sections.h2: What Comanche Trail homes are like
paragraphs: More than 260 homes share this secluded stretch of 78732, and they are a real mix. Custom houses stand next to older builds, prices run from about $550,000 to $1.8 million, and some lots are still available. The area includes plats such as Comanche Trail Estates and Comanche Village. A voluntary HOA charges $25 a year and there is no gate, so access is simple.

The roads wind along the peninsula, with the lake on more than one side. Many houses are oriented toward the water, which puts large panes of glass on the lake side and plain, smaller windows on the street side.

sections.h2: What Comanche Trail windows deal with
paragraphs: Being this close to the lake changes the glass. Spray and moisture off the water carry minerals, and when they dry they leave white spots that can etch if left. Wind through the dam area adds dust and pollen, and cedar pollen settles thickly from December to February. Lake facing glass that takes afternoon sun shows every streak.
Trees on a peninsula also mean webs and leaf litter on screens and tracks. Houses that sit lower near the water collect more of it than those up on the ridge.

We are based in Lakeway, so Comanche Trail is a short drive for us and a regular part of the Four Points route. Pure water and poles that reach up to three stories let us handle tall lake side glass from the ground. Since mixed custom homes vary a lot, we quote by text from your window count or square footage, and Tyler goes over anything unusual with you. Stone and stucco exteriors are soft washed, never pressure washed.
As a sample, a 3,500 square foot lake home runs about $350 for exterior windows and takes around three hours. Hard water removal is $10 per pane for spots that have been there a while.

faq.q: Does lake spray really damage glass?
faq.a: Over time it can. Minerals left by water that dries on the glass build up and can etch. Regular cleaning with pure water keeps them from setting, and spot removal is $10 per pane for older marks.

faq.q: Is Comanche Trail in your service area?
faq.a: Yes. It is minutes from Lakeway, and we work Four Points and the Mansfield Dam area. Most visits happen inside two weeks.

faq.q: Do you clean the high windows facing the water?
faq.a: Yes. Our poles reach up to three stories from the ground, which covers most lake side glass. Interior high windows are done with covered ladders and drop cloths.

faq.q: Can you work around a voluntary HOA?
faq.a: There is no gate on Comanche Trail, so we come straight to the house. If your HOA has guidelines for vendors, tell us in your text and we follow them.
We soft wash limestone and stone with a 12V system. It never gets a hard pressure wash. The house wash price starts at $0.20 per square foot, $400 minimum.
